Synthetic rectangular plate, 200×120×3 mm, without customer data. Built by scaling the Cartesian coordinates of the public 10 mm cube fixture in occt-import-js 0.0.23, test/testfiles/cube-10x10mm/Cube 10x10.stp. File metadata replaced with synthetic metadata. Original public fixture source is documented by that package; package repository https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js at gitHead c2148e54b456b571238d35cac037d304053d64b2.
